howtos.title: Ask your agent how to lighten your cognitive load
howtos.what: Alex Finn's prompt makes your agent review what it knows about you and propose systems, subagents and routines.
copy: My goal for working with you is to lighten my cognitive load. I want to get more work done, but with less effort on my part. Based on what you know about me and what we do together, what are some things we can do, systems we can implement, subagents we can build, or routines we can create to accomplish this goal?
howtos.whenToUse: When you use an agent for a few tasks and suspect it could take over much more of your recurring work.
